report.summary: worker-5c6d in payments is OOMKilled every 3-4 minutes; the container limit is 256Mi and the heap grows past it during batch import.
evidence: describe_pod: Last State Terminated, Reason OOMKilled, limit memory 256Mi
report.root_cause_hypothesis: The batch import loads the whole CSV into memory; 256Mi is below its working set.
proposed_actions: raise the memory limit to 512Mi as a stop-gap
stream the import instead of loading the file
next_checks: memory.events oom_kill in the container cgroup
